title: AI-Specific Observability in Application Insights
description: Monitor LLM token usage, prompt/response costs, hallucination detection, and AI workflow metrics with Azure Application Insights and custom dimensions.

data.text: Beyond CPU and Memory: AI-Native Observability

Traditional APM tools focus on system metrics: CPU, memory, disk, network. AI applications have a different failure mode: the system is 'up' but the LLM is hallucinating, returning irrelevant results, or consuming tokens at unexpected rates. AI observability adds a new dimension — measuring the quality and cost of AI operations alongside system health.

LLM APIs charge per token. Monitoring token usage provides visibility into cost drivers: which endpoints consume the most tokens, which users/projects are most expensive, and whether token usage is growing unexpectedly. Instrument your LLM client to record token counts as custom metrics dimensions.

data.content: Instrumenting LLM calls with token and cost tracking in Application Insights:

data.text: Application Insights workbooks enable custom dashboards that combine AI metrics with system metrics. Key panels: token usage trend (per model), cost breakdown by endpoint, hallucination rate over time, and latency percentiles including TTFT and total generation time.

data.title: Application Insights Workbook Query
data.content: KQL query for AI metrics dashboard in Application Insights:
data.code:
// AI Cost and Token Usage Dashboard
customMetrics
| where name == "ai.cost_usd" or name == "ai.tokens.total"
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize
    total_cost = sum(value),
    total_tokens = sum(value),
    avg_cost = avg(value),
    request_count = count()
    by bin(timestamp, 1h), name, customDimensions.model
| render timechart 

---

// Hallucination Rate Trend
customMetrics
| where name == "ai.hallucination_rate"
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| summarize hallucination_rate = avg(value) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render timechart with (title="Daily Hallucination Rate")

data.text: Set up alert rules for cost anomalies: if daily spend exceeds $500 or token usage spikes 3x above the weekly average, trigger an alert. Use adaptive thresholds that account for legitimate traffic growth.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Track tokens, cost, TTFT, generation latency, and hallucination rate as custom metrics
Dimension metrics by model, endpoint, user ID, and tenant for granular analysis
Set up cost anomaly alerts with adaptive thresholds to catch unexpected spend
Use Application Insights workbooks to combine AI and system metrics in dashboards
Implement automated groundedness checks to measure hallucination rate programmatically
data.takeaway: AI observability extends traditional APM with quality and cost metrics. Instrument your LLM calls with token tracking, cost allocation, and automated quality checks to keep AI applications both performant and economical.
